description:
ABOUT POINTONE

PointOne is the AI revenue platform for professional services.

We’re a Tier 1 venture-backed startup (Y Combinator, Bessemer, 8VC, General Catalyst) that has raised over $20M and grown revenue over 17x over the past 12 months.

WHO YOU ARE

You have:

- 2-5 years of experience at hyper-growth startups and/or leading big tech companies

- A CS degree from a top university

- Strong product sense

- High degree of ownership and the ability to operate autonomously

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

Growth: Our engineers drive the company. You will be expected to quickly take ownership of critical projects and ramp up to own entire products or customers.

Impact: A lot of AI tools have trouble showing real impact. Not us—we deliver hard ROI to our customers (which is one reason why we're one of the stickiest tools in a law firm).

Equity: We want to bet on ourselves and our employees—we offer a highly competitive equity component with any compensation package. We are looking for true builders and innovators.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop novel AI products, providing customers with entirely new workflows.

- Work directly with customers to understand needs, prioritize requests, and translate them into technical solutions.

- Lead by example through mentoring future hires, pairing, and code reviews. You'll shape our engineering culture.

You're excited to work in-person, talk to customers, and drive the development of the next frontier of AI tools.

The compensation for this position is determined by multiple factors, including prior experience and expertise. A competitive equity component will also be offered as part of the package.

Benefits include comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, meals in office, regular team events, a personal wellness fund, a personal learning fund, and more!
